import {test,expect} from '@playwright/test'
test('数据仪表盘模板核心流程',async({page})=>{await page.goto('/');await page.getByLabel('数值', {exact:true}).fill('12.5');await page.getByRole('button',{name:'添加记录'}).click();await page.reload();await expect(page.getByTestId('count')).toHaveText('1');await expect(page.getByTestId('total')).toHaveText('12.50');})
